name: 41041 · Flemingsburg, KY
findings: ZIP 41041 (Flemingsburg) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 41041 (Flemingsburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 41041 (Flemingsburg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
